title: Best LockedIn AI Alternative — Amigo AI Interview Copilot
description: Looking for a LockedIn AI alternative? Amigo offers real-time AI interview help with OS-level stealth, a Buddy feature, and pay-as-you-go pricing — no subscription. Try free, no card.

mainEntity.name: Is Amigo a good LockedIn AI alternative?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Amigo offers the same real-time interview assistance as LockedIn AI, plus features it lacks — a Buddy mode for live human + AI collaboration, full invisibility in Task Manager and Activity Monitor, and pay-as-you-go pricing with credits that never expire instead of a monthly subscription.

mainEntity.name: Is there a free LockedIn AI alternative?

acceptedAnswer.text: Amigo gives every new user 10 minutes of free credits with full feature access — real-time AI answers and the undetectable overlay included. No credit card is required, so you can test a complete session before paying anything.

mainEntity.name: How does Amigo pricing compare to LockedIn AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: LockedIn AI uses monthly subscription tiers with usage credits. Amigo is pay-as-you-go: from $15 for 2 hours, and credits never expire. If you interview occasionally, you don't pay for the months in between.

mainEntity.name: Is Amigo more undetectable than LockedIn AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Amigo is hidden not just from screen sharing, but also from the Dock, Taskbar, Task Manager (Windows), and Activity Monitor (macOS). LockedIn AI's invisibility is focused on screen share — it can still appear in system process lists.

mainEntity.name: Does Amigo support coding interviews like LockedIn AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Amigo's coding interview copilot works with HackerRank, LeetCode, CoderPad, and other platforms. It reads your screen and provides step-by-step hints, time complexity analysis, and working code solutions in real time.

mainEntity.name: Can I try Amigo before switching from LockedIn AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Sign up and you get free credits — no credit card required. Run a full practice interview with Practice Mode or use the free minutes in a real session to compare the experience directly.

The gaps

Why people look for an alternative

LockedIn AI is a popular, broad interview-prep copilot — but a few gaps send users looking elsewhere.

Subscription & Credit Limits

LockedIn AI is built around subscription tiers with usage credits. You pay every month whether or not you have interviews scheduled — and heavier sessions can burn through credits faster than expected.

Not Hidden at OS Process Level

LockedIn AI focuses on screen-share invisibility, but it is not hidden from Task Manager (Windows) or Activity Monitor (macOS). Interviewers who check running processes can spot it.

No Buddy Collaboration

LockedIn AI is AI-only. There is no way to bring a trusted friend or mentor into your session for live human support alongside the AI.

The edge

How Amigo pulls ahead

6 places Amigo outperforms LockedIn AI.

Buddy Feature

Live Human + AI Support

Invite a trusted friend or mentor via a shareable link. They watch your interview in real time and send AI-assisted tips through your Amigo overlay. No other tool offers this two-layer support system.

Deep Stealth Mode

100% Undetectable

Amigo is hidden from screen share, Dock, Taskbar, Task Manager, System Monitor, and Activity Monitor. LockedIn AI's stealth stops at the screen-share level — Amigo's goes down to the OS process list.

Pay-As-You-Go Pricing

No Subscription, Credits Never Expire

Amigo uses credits you buy once — from $15 for 2 hours — and they never expire. No monthly subscription to cancel, no recurring charge between job searches.

Under 0.3s Response

Truly Real-Time

Amigo surfaces short, personalized, natural answers the moment your interviewer finishes speaking. No CTRL+ENTER required — just seamless, in-the-moment support.

Coding Interview Copilot

HackerRank, LeetCode, CoderPad

Amigo reads your screen during live coding challenges and provides hints, pseudocode, time complexity analysis, and working solutions in real time.

Natural STAR Answers

Scenario-Based, Not Robotic

Responses are tailored to your resume and the specific job description — structured in STAR format and adjusted to your preferred length (Concise, Balanced, or Detailed).
